title: Developer Portal | Salesforce Developers | Developer
meta_description: Learn how to build mobile and enterprise applications and agents on Salesforce and deliver innovative experiences using the Agentforce 360 Platform.
clean_text:
The Trailblazer Community in Slack is now in Open Beta–join and connect in real time.

### Introducing AIforce in Action.

Explore a new video series where Salesforce Developer Advocates experiment, build, and share ways to extend Salesforce to new agentic interfaces.

### Get hands-on with the Pronto sample app.

Explore the Headless Toolkit with a new open-source sample app. Learn how to build agentic experiences, connect Salesforce to third-party interfaces, and build once for multiple surfaces using practical patterns and reference code.

### Build with React on Salesforce: Multi-Framework Is Now GA.

Ship production-ready React apps natively on Salesforce — with authentication, security, and governance built in. Here’s what changed in Multi-Framework since beta, and how to migrate.

### Explore virtual events for developers.

Join expert-led workshops, AMAs, and technical sessions to build skills, apply what works, and deliver real business outcomes.

### AIforce in Action

Explore a new video series where Salesforce Developer Advocates experiment, build, and share ways to extend Salesforce to new agentic interfaces.

### Extend Data 360 with Code Extension

Dive into a new video series to learn how to build and debug custom Python code locally, then deploy and monitor it in Data 360 using the Data 360 Code Extension SDK and Claude Code.

### React on Salesforce

Learn how to get started building React apps on Salesforce, including setting up your environment, connecting to Salesforce data, and exploring modern front-end development workflows.

### Data 360 Activated

Learn how to dismantle complex data silos and build a unified data foundation with Data 360.

### The Future of the Salesforce Developer in the Agentic AI Era

The role isn’t shrinking. It’s being redefined, and the developers who see it clearly will define what comes next.

### New in Salesforce Developer Edition: Agentforce Vibes IDE, Claude 4.5, MCP

Salesforce Developer Edition now includes Agentforce Vibes IDE, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Hosted MCP Servers – all free. Here’s what’s new.

### Expose Custom Apex as a Hosted MCP Tool for Agents

Shift from UI-first to agent-first with Headless 360. Learn how to expose your Apex logic as Salesforce Hosted MCP tools, allowing AI agents like Claude or Cursor to discover and invoke your business intelligence directly via the Model Context Protocol.

### Agent Script Decoded: Intro to Agent Script Language Fundamentals

Learn how to master Agent Script to build agents using hybrid reasoning: the perfect balance of deterministic logic and generative power.
